result.title: DisasterVL: Evidence-Based Visual Reasoning Dataset and Model for Disaster Scene Understanding
result.summary: We introduce DisasterVL, a dataset and benchmark for evidence-grounded reasoning about disaster imagery. It contains approximately 1.2 million images from 142 countries, paired with 25 million structured annotations covering scene captions, incident and location assessments, spatial relationships, and visual question answering (VQA). The VQA annotations link answers to visible evidence and include questions about both present and absent cues, multiple answer formats, and difficulty labels. Region-level annotations link caption phrases to bounding boxes and spatial relationships to the regions they connect. The test set contains 38,254 images spanning 75 countries and 28 hazard types. Gemini 3.1 Pro audited the test annotations, and human reviewers validated a stratified subset. On this benchmark, the 9B DisasterVLM model outperforms the evaluated general-purpose baselines on captioning, open-ended VQA, incident reasoning, and region-level grounding. Gains in text overlap are larger than gains in evidence scores. We plan to publicly release the dataset, trained models, and code.

AI.brief_summary: 发布灾害场景的视觉推理数据集与基准，含约120万图像、2500万条涵盖描述、事件与位置评估、空间关系及VQA的结构化标注；VQA答案绑定可见证据并附区域级 grounding，并训练了9B 的 DisasterVLM。
AI.relevance_reason: 答案—证据—区域三层标注可供核查多模态推理是否真正依赖视觉证据，其「文本重叠提升大于证据分数提升」也提示刷分与证据使用脱节，与视觉证据筛选相关；但领域专用，与 LVR 机制本身联系有限。
